items.headline: Bloom Energy Trades at 140 Times Earnings. Here's the Growth Rate It Needs to Justify That.
items.summary: The artificial intelligence (AI) spending spree among giant technology companies has changed the trajectory of Bloom Energy's (BE -8.61%) business. With sales of its hydrogen fuel cells booming, the company's earnings are starting to catch up to its lofty stock price.
